articles.title: Latest Congressional swing at crypto tax reform would direct IRS to review de minimis exemptions
articles.snippet: The newest version of the Parity Act updates language around payment stablecoins and directs the IRS to report on how a de minimis exemption might work.

articles.title: Crypto Long & Short: Bitcoin-backed loans belong in the cost-of-capital conversation
articles.snippet: In this week’s Crypto Long & Short Newsletter, Alec Beckman on why BTC-backed lending is not a crypto story, but a capital efficiency story. Then, Serena Sebastiani on how stablecoins aren’t a crypto product; they’re becoming the settlement infrastructure global finance forgot.

articles.title: Germany's AllUnity plans Swedish krona stablecoin, pushes into AI agentic payments
articles.snippet: The DWS and Galaxy-backed firm targets June debut for its SEKAU stablecoin as Europe pushes to build regulated local-currency alternatives to U.S. dollar tokens.

articles.title: Pan-European stablecoin effort expands to 37 lenders in push back against U.S. dollar dominance
articles.snippet: Qivalis, a stablecoin initiative backed by a group of European banks, aims to issue a stablecoin later this year to deepen the euro's role in tokenized finance.

articles.title: Non-dollar stablecoins are struggling to crack 0.5% of market share
articles.snippet: Everyone is building non-dollar stablecoins. But data shows that compared to USD-denominated stablecoins, almost no one is using them.
